description: This line plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank at 10 (MRR@10) performance metric for various DPR (Dense Passage Retrieval) configurations as a function of the number of queries used during inference, denoted as S. The x-axis, labeled “# of queries used during inference (S)”, is plotted on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 8, with tick marks at integer intervals. The y-axis, labeled “MRR@10”, is also on a linear scale, ranging from 33.5 to 5.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The plot contains five distinct lines, each representing a different DPR variant: a solid black line for “DPR w/o query”, a dashed yellow line with circle markers for “DPR w/ top-1”, a dashed green line with circle markers for “DPR w/ bottom-1”, a dashed purple line with circle markers for “DPR w/ random”, and a dashed red line with circle markers for “DPR w/ curriculum”. The “DPR w/o query” line remains nearly flat at approximately 34.0 throughout the range. The “DPR w/ top-1” line starts at approximately 34.0 and increases to about 36.0 at S=8. The “DPR w/ bottom-1” line begins at approximately 34.0, rises sharply to about 35.5 at S=4, and then continues to increase to approximately 36.5 at S=8.
